assets.prompt:
Edit the supplied 4-column by 4-row sheet IN PLACE. Sixteen equal 288x288 source-coordinate cells, row-major order, do not move, resize, reframe or rearrange any crop. Keep the original skin texture, identity, head direction, nose, jaw contour, hair, costume, lighting and background of EACH specific cell. Only redraw the requested small facial features. NO labels, text, borders, extra objects or new faces. The brown-haired woman Noa is 22, speaking very gently to a frightened adult singer; use restrained natural acting, not a broad cheerful smile. The silver-haired Selene listens, fears failing, then gradually trusts Noa. Exact cell instructions:
ROW 1, COL 1: Noa, quiet resting mouth: lips closed with a tiny compassionate upturn, no teeth, no dark mouth opening. Preserve eyes and eyebrows.
ROW 1, COL 2: Noa, small narrow speaking mouth for Mandarin i/e: only a slim shallow opening, subtle upper teeth allowed; relaxed corners, no grin. Preserve eyes/brows.
ROW 1, COL 3: Noa, moderate soft speaking mouth for a/e, a small vertical oval opening, restrained jaw drop, no exaggerated singing mouth. Preserve eyes/brows.
ROW 1, COL 4: Noa, small rounded pursed mouth for u/o, tiny round opening, rounded lips, no grin. Preserve eyes/brows.
ROW 2, COL 1: Noa, light b/p/m closure: both lips lightly touching, relaxed jaw, no teeth. Preserve eyes/brows.
ROW 2, COL 2: Noa, eyelids HALF closed for the passing phase of one natural blink. Retain exact eyes' size, location and eyebrows. Mouth closed, tiny warm upturn.
ROW 2, COL 3: Noa, both eyes fully closed naturally, original open eye lines fully removed, thin single closed eyelid per eye. Eyebrows in original place. Mouth closed, tiny warm upturn.
ROW 2, COL 4: Noa, after speaking, attentive listening: soften inner eyebrows very slightly and let the gaze settle toward Selene to the right, slightly lowered upper lids. Mouth closed in a modest supportive expression, no grin. Preserve face pose and silhouette.
ROW 3, COL 1: Selene from the first original pose, guarded uncertainty: very subtle inner brow lift and lip tension, lips closed, eyes looking to Noa on her left. Preserve hair, nose and face contour.
ROW 3, COL 2: Same Selene original pose, listening after reassurance: brows relax partway, eyes focus on Noa, lower lids soften, lips still closed. Only a barely perceptible smile, no teeth.
ROW 3, COL 3: Same Selene original pose, half-closed eyelids mid-blink. Keep exact eye positions and eyebrows, lips closed.
ROW 3, COL 4: Same Selene original pose, eyes completely closed for a natural blink, original open eye lines fully gone, single eyelid per eye. Keep brows, nose, mouth and hair fixed.
ROW 4, COL 1: Selene from her held-hand pose, relieved but emotionally contained: soften eyebrows and lower eyelids, tiny closed-lip smile as she meets Noa's eyes. No open mouth, no tears added.
ROW 4, COL 2: Same held-hand Selene, half-closed eyelids, no head movement, original brows and closed lips maintained.
ROW 4, COL 3: Same held-hand Selene, fully closed eyes, remove original open lines completely, single closed eyelids, original brows and closed lips maintained.
ROW 4, COL 4: Selene from the first original pose, glances down with pupils only toward the offered hand at lower left, worried eyebrows soften slightly, lips gently closed. Do not tilt or move her head.
All edits must stay local to each mouth or eye/brow region. No entire-face redraw. Preserve every surrounding pixel as closely as possible.

Edit this exact three-cell horizontal source sheet in place. Keep exactly three equal columns, all framing, image borders, head poses, eyes' centers, faces, skin shading, eyebrows, hair, costumes and all background pixels. Change ONLY the eyelids of the three women, each in her own cell, to a CLEARLY HALF-OPEN blink transition: upper eyelid lowered to the middle of the iris, covering the upper half of the pupil; the LOWER HALF of the iris/pupil and a thin band of eye white MUST STILL BE VISIBLE. This is 50 percent open, NOT a closed-eye line, NOT sleepy squinting at 10 percent open, NOT a fully open eye. Left cell is brown-haired Noa looking to the right; middle cell is original-pose silver-haired Selene looking left; right cell is held-hand-pose Selene looking left. Keep the exact eyebrows and nose untouched. Do not move the heads, eye positions or mouths. No labels, no borders, no new objects, no style change, no skin airbrushing. Preserve source geometry and all untouched pixels very closely. Return the same 3:1 sheet layout.

registration: One similarity transform per same-source cell; only feature islands are composited. Not cross-character or cross-angle transplantation.
rejected: Half-blink cells in the first atlas are too closed; replaced by dedicated half-blink donors.
